daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo Subianto submitted the 2027 budget bill to House Speaker Said Abdullah during the MPR Annual Session on 14 August. The proposed budget targets a deficit of 2.40 percent of GDP and aims for 6 percent economic growth in 2027. In his address, Prabowo thanked PDI-P, with party chair Puan Maharani responding that the coalition must stay united.

  • House Speaker Said Abdullah committed to maintaining accountability and transparency in the 2027 budget and urged fair taxation and prudent debt management in reviewing the bill.
  • Said Abdullah warned tax officials not to intimidate the public when collecting revenue and emphasized the importance of public communication and transparency regarding government policies.
  • Golkar politician Dasco Saputro said the proposal for an ad hoc BUMN court must be studied first, suggesting the president was "too enthusiastic" about the idea.
  • President Prabowo announced plans to establish a new body to overhaul government procurement as part of administrative reforms.
  • DPD Chair revealed nicknames for seven Indonesian presidents, including Soekarno as "Bapak Proklamator" and Jokowi as "Bapak Infrastruktur."
  • The MPR called for an end to wars in the Middle East and encouraged peace efforts during its session.
  • A total of 384 civil servants chose to resign without pension rights, raising questions about the underlying phenomenon.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Indonesian government targets better quality placement of migrant workers in 2027, as the Ministry of Migrant Worker Protection (P2MI) shifts focus beyond simply opening new labor markets. The agency strengthened protection for Indonesian migrant workers throughout the entire cycle, from pre-departure to return. An analyst noted that economic growth and food self-sufficiency are key assets for Indonesia's diplomacy.

  • The UAE Ambassador appreciated President Prabowo's plans for Indonesia's future during bilateral discussions.
  • Japan opened opportunities for new cooperation with Indonesia in three sectors.
  • The Swedish Ambassador highlighted Indonesia's democratic success on the occasion of the country's 81st Independence Day.
  • Saudi Arabia emphasized the importance of strategic relations with Indonesia in recent diplomatic exchanges.
  • The Netherlands Ambassador Gerritsen said the Netherlands is ready to help Indonesia strengthen food security.

Other

Indonesia earmarked Rp 820.9 trillion for education in the 2027 budget, with Rp 240 trillion allocated for the Free Nutritious Meals program (MBG). President Prabowo vowed to fight for all state schools to be tuition-free and stated that children need good education, not just free meals. Finance Minister Purbaya addressed the fate of teacher salaries, indicating whether they will rise or not.

  • Indonesia targets Rp 2,908 trillion in revenue from taxes, customs, and excise in 2027.
  • President Prabowo announced Indonesia Financial Centers in Jakarta and Bali, with positive response from Asian investors.
  • Indonesia plans to launch a Mineral and Commodities Exchange in early 2027.
  • The government deployed strategies to achieve self-sufficiency in beef production.
  • President Prabowo vowed to begin construction of a sea wall along Java's north coast and targets 30 GW of solar power capacity in 2026.
